name: Kids learning songs (ages 4-8, school topics)

format.compilation: every 4 songs → a 30–60 min compilation (watch hours come from compilations)
format.title: The {X} Song | Learn {X} | Kids Learning Songs
format.style: bright cartoon lyric video: recurring characters, big on-screen words that light up as they're sung, one teaching idea per verse, repeated chorus
format.song: lyrics by yt-kids-song; music + vocals made in Suno (paid plan) from the lyrics and style prompt

rpm_notes: Made for Kids: no personalised ads, so RPM is low (often under $1-2). Wins on volume and watch hours (compilations, replays). No comments, no end screens/cards, no notification bell. Revenue upside: streaming the songs (Spotify/Apple via a distributor) and merch.
cadence: 2 songs per week (Wed, Sat 14:00 UTC) + 1 compilation every 2 weeks
